pinned_at_note: SHA256 pins refer to the governance file contents at P5-REV-09 artifact creation; the baseline artifact itself is introduced by the P5-REV-09 commit. State flips to PHASE5_GOVERNANCE_FROZEN only through an explicit Human acceptance record.

authority_rule: Subsequent mutation of pinned governance files requires governance reopen + explicit Human acceptance. The Reviewer must never refresh this baseline by itself.
reopen_policy: Any post-freeze change to governance_files must be submitted as a change record with impact analysis, reviewed by Human, and only then accepted as a new governance baseline revision.
